import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'
import { styles } from './styles'

export function Keyboard() {
    return (
        <View style={styles.container} >

            <View style={styles.containerResultNumber}>
                <Text style={styles.textResultNumber}>0  0  0  0</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.containerNumber}>
                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>1</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>2</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>3</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>4</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>5</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>6</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>7</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>8</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>9</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.containerButton}>
                <View style={styles.buttonLimpar}>
                    <Text style={styles.textButtonLimpar}>Limpar</Text>
                </View>

                <TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text style={styles.textNumber}>0</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <View style={styles.buttonConcluir}>
                    <Text style={styles.textButtonConcluir}>Concluir</Text>
                </View>
            </View>

        </View >
    );
};
